conf.comment: NetApp ONTAP EMS, webhook. Per the work order's own fields_omitted note, NetApp documents that the webhook POST body is XML but does not publish its element names, so no field-level extraction is built here rather than guessing element names against an undocumented schema. This preserves event.original and tags event.dataset only. _time is left to Cribl's default (collection time) since no timestamp field location is known. Capture a real POST body from the cluster, then add XML extraction matching the xml-file pipeline's pattern and delete this gap note.
